# Introduction

## Objectives

By the end of these lectures you should be able to:

::: {.incremental}
- Recognise time series data and explain how it differs from other data
- Read, plot, and manipulate a time series in R
- Identify trend, seasonal, cyclic, and irregular behaviour in a series
- Explain, in plain terms, what stationarity means and why it matters
- Compute lags and differences, and use them to build simple summaries
:::
